ops.sql: SELECT c.Connector_ID, c.Start_Object_ID AS comp, c.End_Object_ID AS iface, o.Name AS iname, o.ParentID, o.Package_ID FROM t_connector c INNER JOIN t_object o ON o.Object_ID = c.End_Object_ID WHERE c.Connector_Type = 'Realisation' AND o.Object_Type = 'Interface' AND o.Package_ID BETWEEN 1124 AND 1152
SELECT d.Diagram_ID, d.ParentID AS owner, d.Name, d.Package_ID FROM t_diagram d WHERE d.Package_ID BETWEEN 1128 AND 1152 AND d.Diagram_Type = 'Sequence'

SELECT x.Diagram_ID, o.Object_ID, o.Object_Type, o.Name, o.ParentID, o.Package_ID, o.Classifier, x.RectLeft, x.RectTop, x.RectRight, x.RectBottom FROM t_diagramobjects x INNER JOIN t_object o ON o.Object_ID = x.Object_ID WHERE x.Diagram_ID IN (SELECT Diagram_ID FROM t_diagram WHERE Package_ID BETWEEN 1128 AND 1152 AND Diagram_Type = 'Sequence') AND o.Object_Type IN ('Object','Component','InteractionOccurrence','Actor','MessageEndpoint','Sequence') ORDER BY x.Diagram_ID, x.RectLeft
SELECT x.Object_ID, o.Object_Type, o.Name, x.RectLeft, x.RectTop, x.RectRight, x.RectBottom FROM t_diagramobjects x INNER JOIN t_object o ON o.Object_ID = x.Object_ID WHERE x.Diagram_ID = 1227
SELECT Package_ID, Name FROM t_package WHERE Parent_ID = 1139 OR Package_ID = 1139

SELECT c.DiagramID, c.Connector_ID, c.SeqNo, c.Name, c.Start_Object_ID, c.End_Object_ID, c.PDATA4 FROM t_connector c WHERE c.Connector_Type = 'Sequence' AND c.DiagramID IN (1196,1198,1200,1202) ORDER BY c.DiagramID, c.SeqNo
